title: Box Art While I Sleep
tagline: Box art for my whole game library, filled in while I slept.
what: A scraper I wrote to fill my handheld game library with box art, screenshots and title screens. It runs unattended for days, matches each game by its file's fingerprint, and never wipes a good game list.
built: Matched games by the file's CRC fingerprint instead of its name, reading it inside zips without unpacking them
Saved each game list through a temporary file, so an empty or broken run can't erase it
Made it remember games the service lacks, and sleep through the daily quota until it could carry on
Added a second, cautious cover pass for Wii, PS2, Switch and other formats a fingerprint can't identify
credit: I wrote it; the art comes from ScreenScraper and SteamGridDB
starring: My game library, and the handhelds that show it

making.problem: The scraper built into my handheld's firmware could not be fixed, and the desktop one doesn't suit a run on a server. I wanted covers for every game without watching it work.
how: It reads each game's CRC fingerprint, asks ScreenScraper for the match, and downloads the box, screenshot, title screen and marquee.
A free account allows about 20,000 requests a day, so the job stops at the quota, sleeps, and picks up again after the reset. The whole library took days.
Games the service doesn't know are written down so they are not asked about again, and each game list is merged through a temporary file.
A weekly fallback searches SteamGridDB for the rest and only takes a cover when the game's name clearly agrees.
credits: Matching and art: ScreenScraper (a free account)

moment.what: On Oct 13, 2026, I cut the library’s missing covers from 962 to 218 with a reviewed cover pass and a cautious name-match pass. About 67 of the remaining entries were BIOS or utility files, not games.
